_brief: Tal 2026-10-03 (batch item 4, Frame.io FLOWERS FOR STRANGERS / OLD LADY JERUSALEM): "Keep this one very wholesome and simple. You can use a little bit of what she says, especially anything about how happy she is, but it doesn't need to be dialogue-heavy. I would rather see: her smiling - close-ups of her reaction - a few of her best words/lines - English captions if she's speaking Hebrew - emotional music underneath." No music file exists (and none is ripped): the cut holds on location sound; the track is still to be added. Captions from cache/translate/local-1f0b76943a391c55.json, RE-READ 2026-10-03 with two models (see its note). KEY FINDING: 'you made me so happy' in the earlier cut is the CAREGIVER saying 'you made HER so happy' - the old lady's lips are closed when it starts. Observer 8345 = POV - 2.03s, 8346 = POV - 35.13s (envelope xcorr, checked on the handover and the hand-hold).
beats: TAL NOTE 2026-10-04 (get me walking up to her, zoom in at me walking up to her): OPEN on the observer iPhone, a constant 1.6x crop held on the right of frame where Tal comes in - his hand and the sunflower enter at 4.3, he steps in at 4.7 and leans to her at 5.0. That is ALL the walk-up this angle has (0.7s; he enters from off-screen right). Sound: his own line from the POV, 4.23-5.43 - EXCUSE ME, THIS IS FOR YOU (slicha, ze bishvilech, both models) - which he says 1.7s BEFORE this picture; his mouth is not readable at this size. Constant crop, no move.
HOOK, one shot: she is wheeled up to us, sees the sunflower, mouth opens in surprise - 'THANK YOU!' (6.5-7.0, both models) NO-ZOOM (LESSONS 80): z:[1,1] for the whole shot.

observer iPhone: Tal, crouched in, puts the sunflower in her hands - the giving SEEN, Tal in frame. POV sound underneath (graft 7.0667). NO-ZOOM (LESSONS 80): z:[1,1] for the whole shot. [r9: same constant 1.6x crop as the opening - one take, one framing]
her face, flower in hand - 'HEALTH AND JOY!' (7.62-8.9) NO-ZOOM (LESSONS 80): z:[1,1] for the whole shot.

ONE SHOT, the emotional centre: she looks up at her bouquet ('wow', uncaptioned) - the camera whips to her caregiver, beaming: 'YOU MADE HER SO HAPPY!' ... 'THAT'S HOW IT SHOULD BE.' - whips back to her, fingers at her lips: 'JUST GIVE JOY, BE HEALTHY!'. Out 27.0667 in the -45 dB gap before her own 'toda lachem'. NO-ZOOM (LESSONS 80): z:[1,1] for the whole shot.

TAL NOTE (her zooming off in slow-mo, on her face, the flowers): SLOW-MO x0.5, LAST IMAGE - she is wheeled toward us, bouquet raised, caregiver smiling behind. Constant 2.2x crop on her face and the flowers (x 0.24, y 0.5), aimed on 13 stills across 8.4-9.5: the man in black never enters this crop before 9.5 (clean window 1.1s; 0.73s used). Proxy only: soft at this crop until the original is fetched.
_sound: bedOnly: the soundtrack is LOCATION-SOUND.wav in this folder - the SAME source windows the beats play (graft window, or real-time window under a slow-mo beat), extracted as continuous runs, denoised once per run (-a 10, 0.5s pre-roll), no per-beat gain. Built by the ek story-editor soundtrack.py (beat-by-beat denoise + level-matching put 20 dB steps and DeepFilterNet onset dips at 4-frame snap joins where the sound is really continuous: measured -64 dB holes at 4.57s/4.70s in r3). Rebuild it if any beat window changes. No music: Tal asked for emotional music on the old-lady cut; none exists in the repo and none is ripped. The track ends with a 0.35s fade: the observer phone hears market chatter right up to the last frame.

The last slow-mo is uncropped (r5 held a 1.8x crop left to keep a man in black out; uncropped he walks on the right, beside her, not between her and the camera). r7: the O47 slow-mo ending is OUT - uncropped (no zoom allowed) a man in black walks through the frame right beside her for the whole shot (seen on r6 frames 13.0-13.7s). The film now ends on the observer wide of Tal holding her hand, BYE.
